verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document any first-party natural-language interface, such as a built-in assistant or a prompt-driven dashboard, for operating Swell. The closest item (swell-docs-21) describes an installable package that teaches a user's external coding agent the file contract, CLI and deploy loop. That is agent-integration tooling, so the natural-language operation would come from a third-party agent rather than Swell itself, which makes it adjacent and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
